notes.title: 7 New Languages! 🎉
notes.notes:
Dear Saviors! 👨‍🚀

I'm proudly announcing that I've implemented a new localization system to the game, that makes switching languages possible in the options menu. 🔥

Although the game's narrative was designed to be non-verbal, I'm aware that many possible players will feel more comfortable playing it in their native language. 

Six major languages and my mother tounge have already been added to the game:

Portugese,
German,
Spanish,
French,
Russian,
Chinese
and Hungarian
localizations are now available.

Huge thanks to the translators! 🙏

If the system seems to be stable and successful, other languages might be added over time. 🚀

Another important upgrade of v1.4.0 is optimization. The second half of Chapter VI has been a performance bottleneck since release. I localized the issue and managed to improve performance significally on all graphics quality level.  🔥

Furthermore, "LOW" quality level will now perform better in all scenes. Some non-essential objects, lights & effects were removed from this tier.

I hope this will be a big leap towards official SteamDeck support as well. 🚀

See detailed [b]patch notes[/b] for v1.4.0 [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/13Tld7YOEVsbPjMMgg18rB5Vf60rAUUpxSrj2cU7uDBY/edit?usp=sharing]here.[/url]

Safe journeys,
[i]K[/i]

notes.title: The Anniv3rsary Update is Live! 🎉
notes.notes:
Dear Saviors! 👨‍🚀

Big news! The 3-year anniversary update has launched today with [b]achievements[/b], a comprehensive [b]visual refreshment[/b], various [b]upgrades [/b]and [b]fixes [/b]on board! 🚀

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41200273/1cc2b8eab4ee0185c667a9eb132b39586d0717a5.jpg[/img]

There are [b]six achievements[/b] to get. Three to track story progress and three for the [b]challenge[/b]. See achievement list [url=https://steamcommunity.com/stats/1751980/achievements/]here.[/url] Progress achievements will be granted to former saviors on first startup. 🏆

Visuals upgrade includes:
🎨 material and texture updates
⛰️ new terrain materials
✨ better effects
🖌️ anti-aliasing
🔥 opimized lights and models

Highest (now called [i]ultra[/i]) quality level may be slightly more demanding to keep up with the needs of [b]better graphics[/b], however, [i]low[/i] settings will perform better than before. Two new graphics quality levels are introduced for balance. 🖼️

[previewyoutube=Dtf4r6w0WTI;full][/previewyoutube]
I also implemented several [b]changes and fixes[/b] to UI, inputs, gameplay and saves.
See detailed [b]patch notes[/b] for v1.3.0 [url=https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/13Tld7YOEVsbPjMMgg18rB5Vf60rAUUpxSrj2cU7uDBY/edit?usp=sharing]here.[/url]

[b]There's more![/b] 🎉

I always wanted to offer something extra to appreciate your financial support, so I created a digital [b]artbook[/b] with 60+ exclusive images and [url=https://store.steampowered.com/dlc/1751980/The_Savior_From_Above/]added it to the Donation DLCs[/url], along with the three original [b]music tracks[/b] from the game. New and former donors can access them from the game's folder upon updating. Thank you for your support! 🙏

Safe journeys,
[i]K[/i]

notes.title: Achievements are finally on their way! 🚀
notes.notes:

Looking forward to sharing more with you! 🔥

Stay tuned,
